title: add-benchmark-lab-profiling-baselines-and-reporting-pipeline-v101
author: Aisha Patel
release_notes: Adds v101 profiling baselines and reporting pipeline; includes improved representative runners and new metrics export. No breaking changes.
body:
Summary: This PR introduces the v101 profiling baselines, a set of representative workload runners, and a new reporting pipeline that exports consolidated perf and memory profiles to BigQuery/metrics. Motivation: The benchmark lab has accumulated ad-hoc runners and exporters. v101 consolidates a stable baseline set (latency/throughput/memory/cold-start) and a unified reporting DAG to support rollout comparisons and regression detection.

What I changed:
- benchmark-lab/baselines/v101/: added JSON baseline definitions and example input workloads for text-gen, chat-streaming, and embeddings.
- benchmark-lab/runners/representative/: introduced runner templates that exercise typical production sequences (short, medium, long contexts) and synthetic mixed workloads.
- benchmark-lab/profiling/exporters/: new pipeline code (Airflow DAG + lightweight exporter) to push consolidated summaries to metrics and BigQuery.
- benchmark-lab/reports/: dashboard templates and alert rule examples for performance regressions.
- docs/benchmark-lab: README describing how to run baselines locally and on CI.

Compatibility and scope:
- No changes to serving runtime code; the change is additive tooling and CI.
- Exporter supports both hosted and dedicated output formats and tags runs with model, instance_type, sequence_profile.

Testing and CI:
- Unit tests for exporter and runner plumbing included.
- Integration job added to CI that runs a fast smoke baseline on a smaller instance.
- Addressed a flakey test by adding a retry and a stronger assertion for async tear-down.

How to review:
- Focus on runner templates and metric names (consistency matters for alerting).
- Verify DAG scheduling and BigQuery export schema in exporters/export_schema.sql.
- Docs/README explains local run commands for reproducing profiles.

Related work:
- Builds on prior reporting pipeline improvements from ENG-19001 and the adaptive-batching work in ENG-19876.

Backwards compatibility: none required. Rollout: merged to main; CI smoke job will gate future profiling runs until next deployment of reporting infra.

Sofia Martinez (reviewer): Can we make the DAG idempotent for reruns? Also request adding model and instance_type tags to all exported rows.
Aisha Patel (author): DAG now marks completed runs and includes model/instance_type tags. Added unit tests for tag population.
Jun Park (reviewer): CI integration job failed once due to ephemeral quota; reran and it passed. Left minor comment about documentation of local run args.

notes: This PR centralizes profiling assets for easier regression tracking. The exporter schema is additive; downstream dashboards will need to be pointed at the new dataset. CI smoke job will run nightly and populate initial baselines.
